source.title: Turn-of-the-candle effect in bitcoin returns
source.claim_tested: Positive Bitcoin minute returns concentrate at minutes 0/15/30/45, potentially associated with scheduled algorithmic demand.
source.translation: Post-publication Binance BTCUSDT spot 2024 open-to-next-open returns. Not an exact replication of Bitfinex execution/fee-tier simulations or the paper's statistical model. Original-vintage paper bytes are not independently timestamp-authenticated.

hypothesis: A long position during the first minute of each quarter hour has positive after-cost expectancy and incremental returns versus matched off-boundary minutes.

mechanism.initiating_driver_hypothesis: Scheduled processing of newly closed 15-minute candles creates asymmetric buying demand.
mechanism.amplifier_hypothesis: Prior aggressive buying imbalance may amplify a boundary price move.
mechanism.consequence: Same-minute taker imbalance is contemporaneous and is not used as a predictive feature.
mechanism.alternative: Clock-time drift, serial dependence, random variation, or trading costs can explain/remove apparent edge.
mechanism.causal_authority: NONE: timing/placebos can falsify implications but cannot identify trader intent or causality; no macro/whale/news/liquidity-depth attribution.

data.data_checks: Exact official URL per month, separate filename-bound provider SHA256 CHECKSUM, bounded ZIP and single expected CSV member, 12 fields, finite valid OHLCV, taker<=total volume, trade count integer, exact close time, sorted unique minute timestamps inside exact month. Missing minutes excluded by complete 15-minute matched blocks; never impute. Report coverage and fail screening if less than 99% eligible blocks.
data.archive_revision_limit: Official historical archives acquired now may contain revisions. Capture retrieval UTC, response metadata, raw hashes and provider checksums. This is not a canonical GitHub acquisition attestation or historical publication-vintage certificate. Positive results remain unadmitted research-only until independent provenance and execution qualification.
data.protected_data: Do not download/read 2025+, project protected datasets, OOS or forward evidence. Fixed BTC market only; no cross-sectional survivor-universe claim.

execution.target: At UTC minute divisible by15: enter its OPEN, exit next minute OPEN, one-minute hold. No leverage, stop, target or alternate boundary search.
execution.latency: Predictive inputs finish at least one minute before entry. Open prices are optimistic execution proxies; the 1-minute delayed control tests timing fragility. No historical order-book or fills are claimed.
execution.flow_score: For five completed minutes [t-6min,t-1min), 2*sum(taker_buy_quote_volume)/sum(quote_volume)-1. Require positive denominator; higher signed aggressive-buy imbalance is the fixed screening score, not calibrated confidence.
execution.price_baseline: Long only when the same five-minute pre-entry close/open return is positive; otherwise cash. Compare on all eligible target opportunities; charge costs only on trades.
execution.base_cost_decomposition: 20bps round-trip fees plus4bps combined spread/slippage. Stress doubles/triples all costs; no rebates or fee-tier bootstrapping. Assumptions, not historical fill evidence.
execution.no_trade: No predictive trading authority unless all downstream gates later pass. Missing/invalid features cause exclusion/NO_TRADE; no negative-flow short leg.

controls.delayed: Same direction at t+1min -> t+2min; full cost.
controls.clock_placebo: Same direction at t+5min -> t+6min; full cost.
controls.random_placebo: Same direction at t+o -> t+o+1min, o=3+int(SHA256(fingerprint+'|'+str(t_ms))[:8],16)%10. Offsets3..12, fixed before outcomes, no parameter search.
controls.ablation: All-boundary long primary versus fixed past-price baseline and predeclared aggressive-flow score subsets. Never choose a best subset after outcomes.

selectivity.fit: Descending score rank ceil(n_train*p/100), inclusive ties; thresholds depend only on training predictors. Apply unchanged to validation.100% means every eligible event.
selectivity.authority: Five non-primary buckets are diagnostic only, cannot rescue a failed primary; a survivor requires genuinely fresh predeclared evidence. Report counts, actual coverage and cost results separately.

gates.primary: All eligible boundary events only. Both train and validation must have positive24bps mean, validation positive72bps mean, both validation quarters positive24bps mean, PF>1 at24bps, no single-winner dependence or catastrophic-tail veto. Must beat clock/random placebos and price-only baseline per opportunity in both halves.
gates.winner_tail: Remove best calendar-day aggregate: remaining mean net must remain positive. Absolute worst net calendar-day loss must be <=50% of total positive-day net pool.
gates.inference: Within each half, aggregate target-minus-clock-placebo gross differences by fixed7-day blocks anchored to that half's start. Exact one-sided sign test on nonzero block sums, no trade-row independence claim. Compute primary plus5 bucket contrasts; Bonferroni over12 planned half/bucket contrasts at family alpha0.05. Zero/tiny blocks reported; sign test assumes independent block signs and is supportive only, not causal or promotion proof.
gates.decision: Negative/weak Stage1 -> reject exact candidate, no tuning or expensive validation. Missing data/power -> INCONCLUSIVE. Positive -> SURVIVOR_REQUIRES_CANONICAL_ADMISSION_AND_FRESH_EVIDENCE, never profitable/promoted. No protected OOS release here.
gates.multiplicity: One new clock-demand family, one primary, five diagnostic subsets, three timing controls and one price baseline. No clock/asset/holding-period searches. Project-wide prior search history persists; no confirmatory budget is minted.
